run_evaluation_cli: run the blink candidate reranking model evaluation on benchmark datasets via command line
evaluate_model_on_dataset: evaluate a BERT reranking model on a dataset and compute normalized accuracy and BM25 recall metrics
evaluate_full_datasets: run full evaluation across all benchmark datasets including AIDA, MSNBC, ACE2004, and Wikipedia
evaluate_aida_only: run evaluation on the AIDA-B dataset only using a pre-trained reranking model
evaluate_with_bm25_recall: evaluate model accuracy and BM25 recall at multiple k values on a dataloader
